title: RoPE Layouts for GQA
summary: Repair a RoPE implementation so it handles both half-split and interleaved layouts on query and key tensors with GQA-style head counts.
fairness_notes: This task uses pure Python lists to stay dependency-light.
The grader allows small floating-point tolerances.
anti_cheat_notes: Hidden grading checks both half-split and interleaved layouts.
Hidden grading verifies that non-rotary tail dimensions remain unchanged.
